name: generator expression vs list comp
code:
print(list(x * 2 for x in range(4)), [x * 2 for x in range(4)])
g = (x for x in range(3))
print(next(g), list(g))

name: generator short circuit
code:
def side(x):
    print('s', x)
    return x
print(any(side(x) > 1 for x in [0, 1, 2, 3]))
print(all(side(x) < 2 for x in [0, 1, 2, 3]))
